verdict.rationale: Intel's marketing repeatedly touts an 'Intel Xe Media Engine' and Arc graphics enabling editing/streaming (docs-1,2,4,6,20), implying hardware media acceleration, but no evidence specifies actual codec support (AV1/HEVC/ProRes) or encode/decode performance, and no independent/hands-on source confirms media-engine behavior — community coverage focuses only on CPU/gaming benchmarks. missing for 10: explicit codec (AV1/HEVC/ProRes) encode-decode spec sheet, independent hands-on verification of media engine performance.
